notes: Curated current local models. Sizes are NOT stored here: `deneb catalog --refresh` (and the Deneb engine's daily landscape job) read real per-quant GGUF file sizes and total params from the Hugging Face API. active_params_b comes from each model card (source field). Add a model = add a row; the refresh does the rest.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.notes: Dense 27B with native vision (needs the mmproj file). Strong all-rounder that fits one 24-32 GB GPU at 4-bit.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.notes: MoE, ~6B active of 125B plus 51B n-gram embedding. Native vision (mmproj). MTP draft files in the repo's MTP/ folder speed up decode.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.notes: MoE, 320B total, 18B active. Needs 128 GB+ even at 2-bit.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.notes: MoE, 117B total, 5.1B active. Ships natively in MXFP4, so every GGUF quant is about the same size: take the native one.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.notes: MoE, 21B total, 3.6B active. Native MXFP4, fits a 16 GB GPU.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next
models.notes: MoE, 80B total, 3B active. Coding agent model.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
models.notes: MoE, 30.5B total, 3.3B active. Very fast coder for 24 GB GPUs and unified-memory boxes.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
